3. In the flyout pane, enter the IP address/IP range/IP subnet you want to exclude. You can
add multiple IP addresses and IP subnets by separating them with a comma.
4. Add a name and note for the exclusion. Select Create to save the exclusion.
To remove an exclusion:
Go to the Identities page. Select the user account you want to remove from the list and
then select Remove.
